description_en: Splits, merges, or changes the scope of reserved instances by modifying configurations such as instance type, quantity, and zone
description_zh: 本接口的主要功能是通过修改实例规格、数量、可用区等预留实例券的配置来对预留实例券进行拆分、合并或范围变更操作
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-reserved-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --reserved-instance-id ecsri-bp15xx20000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyReservedInstances

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the reserved instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
预留实例券所属的地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券ID数组。数组长度：1~20
parameters.name: reserved_instance_id

fields.help_en: The number of pay-as-you-go instances of the same instance type that the reserved instance can match simultaneously. Valid values: ≥ 1
fields.help_zh: 预留实例券可以同时匹配同规格按量付费实例的数量。取值范围：≥1
fields.name: instance_amount

fields.help_en:
The instance type that the reserved instance can match.

Applicable instance types are continuously updated. For more information, see [Reserved instance overview](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~)
fields.help_zh:
预留实例券可以匹配的实例规格。

适用的实例规格持续更新，详情请参见[预留实例券概述](~~100370#3c1b682051vt4~~)
fields.name: instance_type

fields.help_en:
The name of the reserved instance.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh:
预留实例券的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
fields.name: reserved_instance_name

fields.help_en:
The scope of the reserved instance. Valid values: 

Region: regional.
Zone: zonal.

Default value: Region
fields.help_zh:
预留实例券的范围。取值范围： 

Region：地域级别。
Zone：可用区级别。

默认值：Region
fields.name: scope

fields.help_en:
The zone ID of the reserved instance.

This parameter is required when the `Scope` parameter is set to `Zone`.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the zone list
fields.help_zh:
预留实例券所属的可用区编号。

`Scope`参数值为`Zone`时，该参数为必填参数。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html获取可用区列表
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration information of the reserved instances. Array length: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 预留实例券的配置信息数组。数组长度：1~100
parameters.name: configuration
